title: Memory Stores Adventure
welcome_lead: Where does memory live? In three stores. 🧠
meta_desc: Memory & Learning Adventure 1 — KS3 Psychology on sensory, short-term and long-term memory.
final_note: You met the three memory stores and what each holds.

concepts.def: Holds info briefly while in use

Turning info into a brain-friendly form

walkthroughs.body_html:
Memory has three main stores:

  • Sensory — fraction of a second.
  • Short-term — about 20–30 seconds.
  • Long-term — minutes to forever.

STM is like a sticky note.

It holds about 7 items for around 20 seconds.

Try remembering a phone number you just heard — that's STM. 📞

LTM stores everything you remember tomorrow, next year, forever.

To move STM → LTM, you must encode it well — repeat, link to other knowledge, sleep on it. 💤
